comparison_note: The 25-demo run includes the revised shared offline final-review prompt. The interaction run includes the RoboMemArena v2 manipulation/recovery supplement, designed after host review of the baseline. Learners received no held-out feedback. These comparisons change prompts as well as demo/interaction assignments. T04 has 32 demos and 32 interactions in the larger arms; all other tasks have 50. The 25-demo arm has exactly 25 per task. Interactions use each assigned demo seed once.
